text:
andrea: Kicking off a staged rollout for model-serving v3.2.1 -> 10% in eu-west-1. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Deploy bot will post progress. Standby for canary signals.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollout started: service=model-serving version=v3.2.1 target=10% region=eu-west-1 id=rollout-1797779999

mike: @andrea ack. I’ll watch infra metrics and p95.

emma: tagging @sre_oncall for latency and error watch. please call stop if thresholds hit.

sre_oncall: Watching. baseline p95 ~120ms. Will flag if >300ms or 5xx rises.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reached 2% traffic. health: 200 OK=99.8% errors=0.1%

shrey: seeing a small uptick in KV cache miss rate on the eu canary hosts, might explain latency bump.

carlos: Observability note: embedding similarity on perf suite 'semantic-anchors' shows median -3.4% vs v3.2.0 on a sample of 2k queries. not huge but measurable.

mike: that's notable. @andrea do we want the option to pin/hold if quality keeps drifting?

andrea: yes — if signals persist, pause at 10% and pin region to 3.2.0. For now continue to 10% unless SRE calls stop.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reached 10% traffic. health: 5xx=0.8% (baseline 0.12%) p95=420ms (baseline 120ms)

sre_oncall: stop. Increasing 5xx and p95. Pausing rollout. :warning:

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollout paused by SRE (id=1797779999) — current=10%

emma: creating rollback playbook and notifying CS. will update release notes and open an incident ticket.

andrea: Confirm plan: pin eu-west-1 to v3.2.0, start rollback for the affected shard, run a KV warm job, and re-run semantic-anchors eval against canary traffic.

mike: commands to run?

shrey: run:
```
/deploy rollback --service=model-serving --to-version=v3.2.0 --region=eu-west-1 --target=10%
/infra job run kv-warm --region=eu-west-1 --scope=canary
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Accepted rollback job. queued rollback job id=rb-1797779999

carlos: I'll pull eval diffs and post the granular drift soon.

emma: updating release notes: appended "v3.2.1 paused in EU due to latency/quality regressions; rolling back to v3.2.0 for region eu-west-1; investigation ongoing."

andrea: good. ops: after rollback finishes let's do a smoke at 5% for 15m, then if green, re-probe with a narrower config and stricter canary evals.

sre_oncall: agreed. I'll set alert thresholds: p95>250ms or 5xx>0.5% to auto-notify.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback completed: target=10% region=eu-west-1 to_version=v3.2.0 job=rb-1797779999

mike: post-rollback metrics look back to baseline. p95=118ms 5xx=0.09%

andrea: thanks all. Reconvene in 30m to triage root cause and update the staged-rollout checklist (smaller steps + mandatory eval set). I'll file an RFC for improved onboarding checks.

emma: filing incident ticket with links to metrics and eval diffs now.
